summary: [para 3] 3. Notice was issued to the parties to file the reply and rejoinder. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing dated 20.5.2025, the Petitioner was directed to implead POWERGRID (for Bhuj PS) and Adani Energy Solutions Ltd., the TSP of Navinal (for the Mundra S/s) as a party to the Petition and to file a revised memo of parties. Accordingly, the Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 23.5.2025, has filed the revised memo of parties. Further, CTUIL was directed to furnish details of the interconnecting upstream and downstream transmission systems, as well as the connectivity details and GNA grants and/or applications received at Navinal (Mundra) S/s. [¶] - As per the MNRE, the total electricity demand of Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia plants/industries in the Mundra area of Gujarat will be around 22 GW by 2029-30, in phases, as informed during the 22nd NCT meeting. By the 2027-28 time frame, the drawal requirement of 8 GW has been intimated by MNRE. Accordingly, the subject scheme has been planned to meet the additional 3 GW drawal requirement for Green Hydrogen/Ammonia projects (cumulative up to 4.5 GW in the Mundra [para 8] 8. During the course of the hearing, the representative of the Petitioner submitted that all requirements have been duly complied with and, in compliance with the directions issued vide Record of Proceedings dated 20.6.2025, CTUIL has also filed the requisite details. He accordingly requested that the matter be reserved for orders. Further, in response to a specific query of the Commission regarding the planning of the transmission system involved in the present cases, the representative of CTUIL submitted that the said transmission system has been planned on a prospective basis for potential green hydrogen/ green ammonia manufacturers in the Navinal area and, as on date, no application for the grant of connectivity (GNA) has been received from such entities. Accordingly, the matter was reserved for order. [¶] - (a) As per the MNRE, the total electricity demand of Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia plants/ industries in the Mundra area of Gujarat will be around 22 GW by 2029-30 in phases, as informed during the 22nd NCT meeting held on 23.8.2024. By the 2027-28 time frame, the drawal requirement of 8 GW has been intimated by the MNRE. Accordingly, the subject scheme has been planned to meet the additional 3 GW drawal requirement fr Green Hydrogen/ Ammonia projects (cumulative up to 4.5 GW in the Mundra area). However, due to the non-availability of applications, NCT has decided on an extended implementation time frame of 36 months from the date of allocation to the implementing agency. [para 16] 16. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner, BPC, and CTUIL. The instant Petition has been proposed as **"Transmission System for supply of power to Green Hydrogen/Ammonia manufacturing potential in Mundra area of Gujarat under Phase-I: Part B1 scheme (3 GW at Navinal S/s)"** with scope of 2x1500MVA [para 17] 17. We observe that Navinal (Mundra) under Petition No. 426/TL/2024, has a capacity of 6000 MVA and can carry a load of 4500 MW with N-1 criterion. In the said scheme, applications by Bulk consumers have been received for 3050 MW, and a margin of 1450 MW is available, which can be utilized to grant GNA/GNARE to drawee entities.
